title: Engine test
summary: Every kind of beat on borrowed screens from the film: cuts, zooms, rings, the cursor, labels and a clip.

lines.text: This is the engine test. It is not an episode, and nobody should publish it.
A shot fills the frame. Then the camera eases in on one part of it, and a ring is drawn around what matters.
The cursor travels to a button and clicks it, a label names the thing, and the camera pulls back out.
A new chapter pushes its screen in from the right.
Inside a chapter, a beat can cut to another shot, already zoomed in on a rectangle given in pixels.
And a clip plays in the same frame, for things that only make sense in motion.
That is everything the engine can do. Do try to keep up.
